question:
Select the word from among the given options that is closest in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

Sheela was __grateful__ for the support her colleagues provided during a difficult time.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Thankful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Grateful"** means feeling or showing an appreciation of kindness; being thankful. (आभारी)

 
 
• **Example:** She was grateful to her teacher for guiding her through her project.
 
 
 
• **"Thankful"** refers to a feeling of gratitude or being pleased and relieved. (धन्यवादपूर्ण या आभारी)
 
 
• **Example:** I am thankful for the support my family has shown me during tough times.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Thankful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Creative** (रचनात्मक): Involving the use of imagination or original ideas to create something.

 
 
• **Example:** Her creative skills helped design a beautiful poster for the event.
 
 
 
• **Undecided** (अनिर्णीत): Not having made a decision or not having a definite opinion.
 
 
• **Example:** She remained undecided about which college to attend.
 
 
 
• **Spontaneous** (स्वतः स्फूर्त): Happening or done in a natural, often sudden way, without any planning or external cause.
 
 
• **Example:** The audience broke into spontaneous applause after the performance.
